authorization: User requests GitHub CI to publish the built Web SDK to the provided private npm registry under @axiom and supplies its credential for that purpose.
credential_binding: GitHub Actions repository Secret AXIOM_NPM_TOKEN; never a source, fixture, archive or log value

required_changes: Use @axiom/axiom with explicit private registry and preview tag
Publish only the existing verified same-revision Web Release asset after the SDK tag release succeeds
Validate source identity, version, hashes, required assets, safe paths and credential exclusion before npm publication
Update the actual external npm consumer and user documentation
forbidden_changes: Runtime behavior or public API changes
Semantic/Skia SDK lock edits or dependency rebuilds
Publishing an ad hoc local test version
Merging main or replacing old evidence
required_tests: Release/npm guard unit regressions with a witnessed RED
Real npm pack/dry-run and offline scoped consumer install/typecheck using actual built SDK bytes
Actual Chrome/WASM qualification of the extracted npm payload

optional: First real SDK tag build and private publication; not triggered by this task

execution_closure_contract.terminal_success: Tests pass, workflow and consumer naming agree, Secret configured without exposure, exact implementation committed and pushed with evidence and first-publication limitations reported
